![](https://storage.googleapis.com/blogs_josa/sport/blog_assets/2012-09-02_BUPA_GREAT_YORKSHIRE_RUN/img/thumbnail/00.jpg)

Another edition of my home race in Sheffield, UK. Always the same race going from the Crucible towards the Morrisons in Hillsborough Park area, and back. As always, a lot of runners, and a lot of cheering people and bands. Great atmosphere.
